name: set_text_style
description: Modify text style in a shape's TextFrame while preserving other run-level font properties. Use scope='range' to style a substring (requires char_start_index + target_text). Use scope='all' to restyle the entire text in the shape (range fields ignored). For table cells use cell_text_style instead.

scope.description: 'range' = style only the substring identified by char_start_index/target_text. 'all' = apply to the entire text in the shape; char_start_index/target_text/char_end are ignored.

char_start_index.description: Required when scope='range'. 0-based character start index.

target_text.description: Required when scope='range'. Exact substring to be styled (used for range validation).

char_end.description: Optional. Used only when scope='range' as fallback validation.

bold.description: Whether to set bold (other runs remain unchanged)

italic.description: Whether to set italic (other runs remain unchanged)

underline.description: Whether to set underline (other runs remain unchanged)

name: edit_text_insert
description: Call when the user explicitly requests to insert or add text at a specific position.

preceding_text.description: Exact text immediately before insertion point. Use '[SOS]' if inserting at start.

name: edit_text_delete
description: Call when the user explicitly requests to delete or remove specific text.

preceding_text.description: Exact text immediately before the target text. Use '[SOS]' if target is at start.

name: edit_text_replace
description: Call when the user explicitly requests to replace specific text with new text inside a shape.

preceding_text.description: Exact text immediately before the target text. Use '[SOS]' if replacement starts at beginning.

name: edit_text_rewrite
description: Fully rewrite the entire text content of a shape with style preservation. Use ONLY when the entire text must be translated, summarized, restructured, or meaningfully transformed. Do NOT use for partial edits — use edit_text_insert, edit_text_delete, or edit_text_replace instead. CRITICAL: new_text MUST preserve the original paragraph structure — use \n separators so the resulting paragraph count matches the source shape's paragraph count. Losing line breaks/bullets is the single most common failure mode for this tool.

new_text.description:
The complete new text. MUST include the same number of paragraph separators (
) as the original shape's paragraph count — examine the source shape's paragraph list in slide JSON and insert exactly that many newlines between segments. Each 
 is one paragraph boundary; consecutive 

 yields a blank paragraph. Bullets are paragraph-level and preserved automatically — do NOT add bullet characters (•, -, 1.) into the text.

name: update_chart_categories
description: Updates only the X-axis category labels of a chart. No other chart properties will be modified.

name: update_chart_series
description: Adds, removes, or renames data series in a chart.

series_index.description: 0-based index of the series to rename (0 = first series).

add.description: Add a new data series. IMPORTANT: a chart's X-axis categories are CHART-GLOBAL — the new series' values are plotted at the chart's existing categories, in order. You MUST supply `values` whose length equals the chart's existing category count, putting the intended number at the matching category index and 0 elsewhere. Example: chart has categories ['VS','S','N','D','VD'] and the user asks to add series 'Neutral' with value 22 — pass values=[0,0,22,0,0] (22 at the 'N' index). Do NOT pass a single-element values list expecting only one bar; that misaligns with chart-global categories. Omit `categories` unless you intend to overwrite the chart-global X-axis labels for ALL series.

values.description: Series values, one per existing chart category in chart order. Length MUST equal the chart's existing category count.

categories.description: Optional. Only provide if you want to REPLACE the chart-global X-axis labels for ALL series (rare). Normally OMIT — existing chart categories are used automatically.

delete.description: 0-based index of the series to delete (0 = first series).

name: update_chart_structure
description: Updates chart structure settings such as type, title, and legend position.

name: update_chart_axes
description: Updates axis-related settings such as scale and axis title.

name: update_chart_colors
description: Updates colors of chart series.

series_colors.description: List of color assignments. Each entry colors either an entire series (when point_index is omitted) or a single data point within a series (when point_index is provided). Use per-point form to give each column / pie slice / marker a different color.

series_index.description: 0-based index of the target series (0 = first series).

point_index.description: Optional 0-based index of the specific data point (column / slice / marker) to color. Omit to color the whole series.

name: cell_text_style
description: Change text style inside a single PowerPoint table cell while preserving run-level font styles. Text content is not modified.

shape_id.description: PowerPoint Shape ID (must be a table)

slide_json.description: Parsed slide JSON containing run-level text and font information

row_index.description: 1-based row index of the target table cell

col_index.description: 1-based column index of the target table cell

char_start_index.description: 0-based character start index for applying style

target_text.description: Target text used to resolve the character range

char_end.description: Optional 0-based character end index for the style range

name: replace_table_text
description: Replace text inside a PowerPoint table cell while preserving run-level and paragraph-level styles. Uses a simple replacement path for single-run cells and an LLM-based style mapping path for complex cells.

shape_id.description: PowerPoint Shape ID (must be a table)

row_index.description: 1-based row index of the target table cell

col_index.description: 1-based column index of the target table cell

new_text.description: The final text that should appear in the table cell after replacement

slide_json.description: Parsed slide JSON containing run-level and paragraph-level metadata

agent_request.description: Structured LLM request describing how the text should be transformed

task_description.description: Natural language description of the task

action_type.description: Type of action to perform (e.g., rewrite, summarize, translate)

slide_contents.description: Additional structured context related to the slide or table cell

name: table_layout_style
description: Manage PowerPoint table structure and visual layout styles without modifying text content or text styles. Supports adding or deleting rows and columns, merging or splitting cells, and applying visual styles such as background color, alignment, and borders.

shape_id.description: PowerPoint Shape ID (must be a table)

structure_actions.description: List of structural modifications to apply to the table

index.description: 1-based index for delete operations (required for delete_row and delete_col)

style_actions.description: List of visual style actions to apply to table cells

target.description: Target cell selector (supports single cell, row, column, or entire table)

row.description: 1-based row index or '*' for all rows

col.description: 1-based column index or '*' for all columns

styles.description: Visual styles or cell modifications to apply to the target cells

bg_color_hex.description: Background fill color in hex format (e.g., #FFFFFF)

horizontal_align.description: Horizontal text alignment inside the cell

merge_with.description: Merge the target cell with another cell

row.description: 1-based row index of the merge target cell

col.description: 1-based column index of the merge target cell

split.description: Splits the target cell into a specified number of rows and columns.

rows.description: Number of rows to split the cell into (default is 1)

cols.description: Number of columns to split the cell into (default is 1)

name: manage_bullet_points
description: Applies bullet or numbering styles to text.

name: set_paragraph_alignment
description: Adjusts paragraph-level formatting: text alignment, line spacing, and space before/after paragraphs.

line_spacing.description: Line spacing multiplier (e.g., 1.0 for single, 1.5 for 1.5x, 2.0 for double).

name: adjust_layout
description: Adjusts shape position, size, and rotation.

name: distribute_shapes
description: Distributes multiple shapes evenly. By default distributes within existing shape range. Set use_slide_bounds=true to distribute across the full slide width/height.

spacing.description: Fixed spacing in points between shapes. If omitted, distributes evenly.

use_slide_bounds.description: If true, distribute across the full slide width/height instead of existing shape range.

margin.description: Margin from slide edges in points when use_slide_bounds is true. Default 0.

name: align_shapes
description: Aligns multiple shapes. Supports shape-to-shape alignment and slide-based centering.

align_type.description: left/right/top/bottom/center_h/center_v: align shapes to each other. slide_center_h/slide_center_v/slide_center: center the group of shapes on the slide (works with 1+ shapes).

name: create_textbox
description: Creates a single textbox. Allows flexible and custom positioning on the slide. Run-level styling is supported.

runs.description: One or more run segments forming a single paragraph.

name: create_placeholder
description: Creates a layout-bound placeholder (e.g., title, subtitle, body, footer) positioned according to the slide's default MS Office layout. This is used for structurally defined text areas with fixed semantic meaning. Run-level styling is supported within the placeholder.

placeholder_type.description: Defines the semantic placeholder type. The position is automatically determined by the slide layout and cannot be manually overridden.

runs.description: One or more run segments forming a single paragraph inserted into the placeholder.

name: create_shape
description: Creates a new shape on a slide. Text content can be added, and detailed shape styling (fill and line) can be configured.

text.description: Text content to place inside the shape. Text style cannot be configured here.

fill_color_hex.description: Fill color of the shape in hex format (e.g., #FF0000).

line_dash_style.description: Line dash style (PowerPoint msoLineDashStyle enum value).

name: delete_shape
description: Deletes a shape from a slide by shape ID.

shape_id.description: ID of the shape to delete.

name: duplicate_shape
description: Duplicates a shape and places it at a specific position.

left.description: New left position of duplicated shape.

top.description: New top position of duplicated shape.

name: duplicate_shape_within_slide
description: Copies a shape from a source slide and pastes it into a target slide, preserving position, size, formatting, and content.

shape_id.description: The Id of the shape to duplicate.

source_slide_number.description: 1-based slide number where the shape currently exists.

target_slide_number.description: 1-based slide number where the shape will be pasted.

name: apply_visual_style
description: Applies fill, line, transparency, and shadow styles.

name: apply_gradient_fill
description: Applies a gradient fill to a shape.

name: set_shape_font_size
description: Bulk-set font_size on every run inside a shape's TextFrame. Use to uniformly shrink or grow text in one shape (e.g. fix TEXT_OVERFLOW). Other font properties (color, bold, italic) are preserved.

shape_id.description: Target shape's id from the slide JSON

font_size.description: New font size in points (e.g. 18). Applied to all runs in the shape.

name: set_shape_paragraph_spacing
description: Bulk-set paragraph spacing on every paragraph of a shape's TextFrame. Use to relieve vertical TEXT_OVERFLOW by tightening line height or paragraph padding without shrinking the font. Each parameter is optional and independent.

shape_id.description: Target shape's id from the slide JSON

line_spacing.description: Line-height multiplier. Allowed range 0.8 ~ 1.5 (values outside are clamped). 1.0 = single line, 1.5 = 1.5x. Optional.

space_before.description: Space above each paragraph, in points. Optional.

space_after.description: Space below each paragraph, in points. Optional.

name: add_slide
description: Adds a new slide.

name: delete_slide
description: Deletes a slide.

name: duplicate_slide
description: Duplicates a slide.

name: insert_image
description: Search for, generate, or load an image and insert it onto a slide. Use image_source='search' to find images online (Pexels/Unsplash), 'generate' to create images via AI (Gemini Imagen), or 'file' to insert a local image file.

image_source.description: 'search' to find images online, 'generate' to create via AI, 'file' to use a local path

query_or_prompt.description: Search query (for 'search'), generation prompt (for 'generate'), or file path (for 'file')

width.description: Image width in points (optional, keeps original aspect ratio if omitted)

height.description: Image height in points (optional, keeps original aspect ratio if omitted)

name: edit_image
description: Edit an existing image on a slide using AI (Gemini). Exports the image, applies the edit prompt via Gemini, and replaces the original image at the same position and size.

shape_id.description: Shape ID of the image to edit

edit_prompt.description: Natural language instruction describing how to edit the image (e.g., 'change background to sunset', 'make it black and white', 'add bokeh effect')

name: set_slide_transition
description: Sets a slide transition effect. Available types: none, fade, push, wipe, split, cover, uncover, dissolve, cut, random_bars, checkerboard, morph.

advance_on_time.description: Auto-advance after N seconds. If omitted, slide advances on click.

name: set_slide_background
description: Sets the background of a slide. Supports solid color, gradient, or reset to master slide background.
